title: RAW_UNSCREENED: cheedy als Bewegung oder Ruhezustand
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f77r.37 contains cheedy cheey lchedy; f77r.18 and .43 contain more cheedy contexts.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed source lines and cached report outputs; no new selectors, images or reserves.
design.mechanism: Motion reading assigns an event; rest reading assigns a state under one fixed whole-form value.
design.unit: Exact whole-form occurrences at the named loci.
design.prediction: Motion predicts written target/direction/result; rest predicts state holder and no directional complement.
concrete_observations: GDT936 records two cheedy on f77r.18 and a later qotaiin context on .43, preserving all unknown neighbors.
linked_consequences: Motion requires a written direction/result at each nominated occurrence; rest requires a stable host and must not borrow motion words.
design.distinguishing_observation: Compare exact complements and subject candidates across occurrences; missing targets remain open.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Most cheedy contexts lack enough written participants for either event or state binding.
